translations.<accent>Averse (Blade Storm)</accent> es: <accent>Blade Storm</accent> is Jett's ultimate. Activate the ability to equip a set of <accent>5 deadly knives</accent> with pin-point accuracy. Each knife deals <accent>50 body damage</accent> and <accent>150 head damage</accent> (instant kill). The weapon is perfectly accurate even while moving and jumping, making it the ideal tool combined with Jett's Dash and Drift to become an almost impossible target to hit. Every kill <accent>resets all knives</accent> to 5, making this ultimate potentially infinite during a multi-kill. Cost: <accent>7 ultimate points</accent>.
translations.<accent>Courant ascendant (Updraft)</acc: <accent>Updraft</accent> is Jett's vertical mobility ability. Activate the ability to instantly propel yourself into the air. This vertical boost allows you to reach high positions inaccessible to other agents, such as top of boxes, containers, or structures. Combined with Jett's passive <accent>Drift</accent> capability (holding jump in mid-air), this ability becomes a formidable tool to take unexpected angles and surprise enemies from above. Cost: <accent>150 credits</accent> 1 maximum charge.
translations.<accent>Éclats de nuage (Cloudburst)</ac: <accent>Cloudburst</accent> is Jett's vision-blocking ability. Instantly throw a projectile that expands into a vision-blocking cloud of smoke upon impact with a surface. It is a highly responsive tool, ideal for creating emergency cover, blocking the sightline of an enemy sniper (Operator), or facilitating an entry dash onto site. The smoke dissipates very quickly (<accent>2.5 seconds</accent>), requiring perfect timing to gain maximum advantage.

translations.<accent>Vent arrière (Tailwind)</accent>: <accent>Tailwind</accent> is Jett's signature mobility ability, feared for its unpredictability. Press the ability key once to <accent>prepare</accent> it. After a brief moment, a <accent>12-second</accent> window activates. During this time, you can reactivate the ability to perform an extremely fast dash. It is the perfect tool for taking highly aggressive duels (especially with a sniper) and instantly escaping before the enemy can trade, or for breaking defense lines when taking a site. The ability recharges after getting <accent>2 kills</accent>.
